---

## 1. Load Data and Shapefile

```{r load}
panel <- read_csv("../data/processed/final_data_monthly.csv",
                  col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character()))

demo <- read_csv("../data/processed/cbg_demographics.csv",
                 col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character()))

cross <- panel %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta_pm25   = mean(mean_delta_pm25,   na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_trips_worse   = mean(pct_trips_worse,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mobility_adj_pm25 = mean(mobility_adj_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    residential_pm25  = mean(residential_pm25,  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_destinations    = mean(n_destinations,    na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(demo, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    log_median_income = log(median_income),
    state = case_when(
      substr(GEOID, 1, 2) == "11" ~ "DC",
      substr(GEOID, 1, 2) == "24" ~ "MD",
      substr(GEOID, 1, 2) == "51" ~ "VA"
    )
  )

# Load CBG shapefile
dmv_counties <- c("11001","24031","24033","51013","51059","51510","51600","51610")

cbg_shp <- map_dfr(c("DC","MD","VA"), ~block_groups(state = .x, year = 2019, cb = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(substr(GEOID, 1, 5) %in% dmv_counties) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# Join cross-section to shapefile
cbg_sf <- cbg_shp %>%
  left_join(cross, by = "GEOID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_delta_pm25))

cat("CBGs with geometry and outcome:", nrow(cbg_sf), "\n")
```

---

## 2. Choropleth Maps

```{r choropleth-delta, fig.cap="Figure 6. Spatial distribution of mean delta PM2.5 across DMV CBGs."}
ggplot(cbg_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_delta_pm25), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "#4575b4",
    mid      = "white",
    high     = "#d73027",
    midpoint = 0,
    name     = "Delta\nPM2.5\n(ug/m3)",
    labels   = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Mobility-Driven PM2.5 Exposure Differential",
    subtitle = "Mean (destination PM2.5 - origin PM2.5) per CBG, 2018-2021",
    caption  = "Red = travels into worse air | Blue = travels into cleaner air"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r choropleth-residential, fig.cap="Figure 7. Residential PM2.5 baseline per CBG."}
ggplot(cbg_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = residential_pm25), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name   = "Residential\nPM2.5\n(ug/m3)",
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Residential PM2.5 Baseline",
    subtitle = "Mean annual PM2.5 at origin CBG, 2018-2021"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## 3. Spatial Weights

```{r weights}
nb <- poly2nb(cbg_sf, queen = TRUE)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

cat("Queen contiguity neighbour summary:\n")
print(summary(nb))
```

---

## 4. Global Spatial Autocorrelation — Moran's I

```{r morans}
moran_vars <- c("mean_delta_pm25", "pct_trips_worse", "residential_pm25",
                "mobility_adj_pm25", "pct_nonwhite", "pct_poverty",
                "median_income", "pct_no_vehicle")

moran_results <- map_dfr(moran_vars, function(v) {
  x <- cbg_sf[[v]]
  x <- if_else(is.na(x), mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), x)
  mt <- moran.test(x, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
  tibble(
    variable      = v,
    moran_i       = round(mt$estimate[1], 4),
    p_value       = round(mt$p.value, 6),
    interpretation = if_else(mt$p.value < 0.05,
                             if_else(mt$estimate[1] > 0,
                                     "Clustered (+)", "Dispersed (-)"),
                             "Random")
  )
})

moran_results %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 8. Global Moran's I for Key Variables")
```

```{r correlogram, fig.cap="Figure 8. Spatial correlogram showing decay of autocorrelation in mean delta PM2.5 across 5 lags."}
x_delta <- cbg_sf$mean_delta_pm25
x_delta <- if_else(is.na(x_delta), mean(x_delta, na.rm = TRUE), x_delta)

sp_corr <- sp.correlogram(nb, x_delta, order = 5,
                           method = "I", zero.policy = TRUE)

sp_corr_df <- tibble(
  lag   = 1:5,
  I     = sp_corr$res[, 1],
  lower = sp_corr$res[, 1] - 1.96 * sqrt(sp_corr$res[, 3]),
  upper = sp_corr$res[, 1] + 1.96 * sqrt(sp_corr$res[, 3])
)

ggplot(sp_corr_df, aes(x = lag, y = I)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2, fill = "#2166ac") +
  geom_line(color = "#2166ac", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "#2166ac", size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  labs(
    x     = "Spatial Lag",
    y     = "Moran's I",
    title = "Spatial Correlogram — Mean Delta PM2.5",
    subtitle = "Autocorrelation decays but remains significant through 5 lags"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

---

## 5. Local Spatial Autocorrelation — LISA

```{r lisa}
lisa      <- localmoran(x_delta, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
xz        <- scale(x_delta)[, 1]
lagz      <- lag.listw(lw, xz, zero.policy = TRUE)
lisa_p    <- lisa[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]

cbg_sf <- cbg_sf %>%
  mutate(
    lisa_quad = case_when(
      xz > 0 & lagz > 0 & lisa_p < 0.05 ~ "HH — High cluster",
      xz < 0 & lagz < 0 & lisa_p < 0.05 ~ "LL — Low cluster",
      xz > 0 & lagz < 0 & lisa_p < 0.05 ~ "HL — Outlier",
      xz < 0 & lagz > 0 & lisa_p < 0.05 ~ "LH — Outlier",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

cat("LISA cluster counts:\n")
print(table(cbg_sf$lisa_quad))
```

```{r lisa-map, fig.cap="Figure 9. LISA cluster map of mean delta PM2.5. HH clusters (red) in suburban ring; LL clusters (blue) in DC urban core."}
lisa_colors <- c(
  "HH — High cluster"  = "#d73027",
  "LL — Low cluster"   = "#4575b4",
  "HL — Outlier"       = "#fdae61",
  "LH — Outlier"       = "#abd9e9",
  "Not significant"    = "gray90"
)

ggplot(cbg_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = lisa_quad), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lisa_colors, name = "LISA Cluster") +
  labs(
    title    = "LISA Cluster Map — Mean Delta PM2.5",
    subtitle = "Local Moran's I, p < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## 6. Demographic Maps

```{r demo-maps, fig.cap="Figure 10. Spatial distribution of key demographic predictors."}
map_demo <- function(sf, var, title, palette = "Blues") {
  ggplot(sf) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[var]]), color = NA) +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = palette, direction = 1,
                         name = NULL,
                         labels = number_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"))
}

p1 <- map_demo(cbg_sf, "pct_nonwhite",   "% Nonwhite",        "RdPu")
p2 <- map_demo(cbg_sf, "pct_no_vehicle", "% No Vehicle",      "Oranges")
p3 <- map_demo(cbg_sf, "pct_poverty",    "% Poverty",         "YlOrRd")
p4 <- map_demo(cbg_sf, "median_income",  "Median Income ($)", "Greens")

library(patchwork)
(p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Demographic Predictors — Spatial Distribution")
```

---

## 7. Temporal Moran's I

```{r temporal-morans}
temporal_moran <- map_dfr(2018:2021, function(yr) {
  yr_cross <- panel %>%
    filter(year == yr) %>%
    group_by(GEOID) %>%
    summarise(mean_delta = mean(mean_delta_pm25, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  yr_sf <- cbg_shp %>%
    left_join(yr_cross, by = "GEOID") %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean_delta))

  nb_yr <- poly2nb(yr_sf, queen = TRUE)
  lw_yr <- nb2listw(nb_yr, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
  mt    <- moran.test(yr_sf$mean_delta, lw_yr, zero.policy = TRUE)

  tibble(
    year    = yr,
    moran_i = round(mt$estimate[1], 4),
    p_value = round(mt$p.value, 6),
    n_cbgs  = nrow(yr_sf)
  )
})

temporal_moran %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 9. Moran's I on Mean Delta PM2.5 by Year")
```
